title: Dunder Mifflin Infinity
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Jim and Pam reveal their romantic relationship to the office, receiving mixed reactions. Ryan returns as the new boss, introducing the Dunder Mifflin Infinity initiative and mandating new technology like Blackberries, causing tension among employees, especially Michael and Creed, who fear for their job security. Dwight and Angela's secret relationship is exposed but ends due to Angela's emotional distress over her cat Sprinkles. Michael confronts Ryan about perceived ageism in the new business plan, while company founder Robert Dunder visits. Meanwhile, Toby introduces his girlfriend Amy to the office, leading to a humorous conflict over PDA rules.
